6e048ac98506f4ba82292dc44adfa9ef208a1bef.summary: This is a GitHub project page for NimBlackout, a proof-of-concept tool written in Nim by the user Helixo32. It is described as an adaptation of the Blackout project by ZeroMemoryEx and is said to remove antivirus and EDR products using a vulnerable-driver (BYOVD) technique. The page is a code repository README, not a threat report on observed activity, so no threat facts are recorded.
hedges: The project is stated to be for educational purposes only, and the author disclaims responsibility for misuse.

6eb53e3942c14de6b0d14f42eef6409a5d6fac5a.summary: S2W LAB report on the July 2021 Kaseya VSA supply chain attack. Attackers reportedly bypassed authentication on the VSA web panel and pushed ransomware to connected clients via a hotfix package that disabled antivirus. REvil is named as the ransomware group, asking $40,000 to $45,000 per file extension or $500,000 for full decryption. Managed service providers Visma EssCom, Synnex and Avtex are listed, with over 1,000 companies estimated affected, including Swedish supermarket and pharmacy chains and SJ public transport. The attacker reportedly said no data was stolen.
